sloka: नूनं लङ्का हते पापे रावणे राक्षसाधिपे ।शोषं यास्यति दुर्धर्षा प्रमदा विधवा यथा ।। ५.२४.२७।।।।
transliteration: nūnaṁ laṅkā hate pāpe rāvaṇe rākṣasādhipe ।śoṣaṁ yāsyati durdharṣā pramadā vidhavā yathā ।। 5.24.27।।।।

translations.english: 'If you do not heed our words of advice, all of us will eat you at this very moment.'
